name: 35 Electric
source:
A former model moves to an unfamiliar neighborhood in the Pacific Northwest and finds it harder than usual to make friends.

Shirley Wright used to lead a comfortable life in Las Vegas. But after a doctor recommends a change of climate for her husband’s lung injury, Shirley finds herself at odds with the friendly but flighty housewives of her new cul-de-sac. What could they be hiding?
